title: Associate .scap files with Stratoshark
description:
3b4c215a5f associated .scap files with Wireshark. Make sure they're just
associated with Stratoshark.

Split our wiretap file extension lists into separate versions based on
application flavor.

Fixes #20583

commits_data.message:
Associate .scap files with Stratoshark

3b4c215a5f associated .scap files with Wireshark. Make sure they're just
associated with Stratoshark.

Split our wiretap file extension lists into separate versions based on
application flavor.

Fixes #20583
